topics.description: how the project is marked, and sharing your game

blocks.text: You make one game with your team. It is marked in stages, so you get feedback along the way. The stages follow the Australian STEM Video Game Challenge rubrics.

rows: Game Design Document: Planning section and team plan
Game Design Document: Designing section and a playable prototype
The game: functionality, gameplay, visual and audio, technical, engagement, theme
Game Design Document: Reflecting section, testing evidence, screen recording
A short review, evaluation and demonstration
